title: The Last Space Cop and the Bug With a God Complex
description: Something punched a hole in the universe, and the Nova Corps caught the whole invasion in the face. Meet the last man standing.
hook_note: Opens on a named man declared the last of an entire galactic police force before we even see the enemy.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: This is Richard Rider. Nova. The last living officer of the Nova Corps.

segments.text: This is Richard Rider.
Nova. The last living officer of the Nova Corps.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: The whole Corps. Gone. And it started when something punched through the Crunch.

segments.text: The whole Corps. Gone.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: The Crunch being the literal edge of our universe. So yeah.
